pages.text: One wire, two cargos. The $(item)MC3D Cable$() carries $(l)both$() Redstone Flux and Filament Units down a single line.$(br2)It connects $(l)automatically$() to printers, fabricators, $(item)Filament Racks$(), generators, and any other mod's RF machines — no configuring faces.

pages.title: Power (RF)
pages.text: The cable moves standard Forge Energy, but $(l)modestly$() — $(l)2,000 FE/t$() (tunable in config).$(br2)That's plenty to run this mod's machines, and you can use it as a general-purpose power wire for $(l)any$() mod. It is deliberately $(l)not$() an endgame power backbone — for serious throughput, bring a dedicated cable.

pages.title: Filament Units
pages.text: Filament Units are pulled $(l)on demand$(). A printer wired to one or more $(item)Filament Racks$() drains them the moment its own docked spools run dry, so a single rack can feed a whole row of machines.$(br2)Transfer is $(l)lossless$() — no Filament Units lost to distance.
Cheap to craft, and one batch yields $(l)6$(). Run it wherever you need power or filament.
